headline: Housing and Land Use Committee members ask to defer property tax item

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Members asked to defer an item after staff who could answer questions were not present. Earlier discussion included the Finance Department's description of a tax correction as a department error.
meeting.recap: A member asked to defer the item because staff who could answer questions were not present.[[0:22:56]] Another member also asked to defer it.[[0:23:20]]
meeting.next: Members asked that the item be deferred.

moments.q: "finance itself labeled the correction as department error"
"I think it's time to just defer this and be done with it."
